[[File:Jonny Chu 2026 US Nationals.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Jonny Chu at the [[2026 U.S. National Championship]].]]
'''Jonny Chu''' (GEMP handle '''mryellow''')<ref name="retro-gempc-86781">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/Player_List_for_2026_Retro_GEMPC_forum_t86781 Internet Archive]. [[:File:SWCCG forum t86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC.txt]]</ref> is a long-standing member of [[Team Albany]] and later [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]]. He won the [[2026 Retro U.S. Nationals]].<ref name="pc-rusn26" /> Chu also finished '''#2''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] (Dark: ROps; Light: TRM).<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2026_Retro_GEMPC_starwarsccg_org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>


Before the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] he playtested [[Operatives]] with [[Matt Sokol]].<ref name="sokol-pds2">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jFXqTc1jkNc&t=1360s SWCCG PDS2: Matt Sokol, Worlds 2000 Champion Interview, HB X-wing Numbers, ISB Sandwhirl], BillBisco2 (6 May 2025), 22:40–28:40. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-jFXqTc1jkNc Internet Archive]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008224620/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jFXqTc1jkNc watch-page snapshot] (Wayback 8 October 2026).</ref> At [[DecipherCon 2000]] he won Sunday's four-player team championship with [[Matt Sokol]], [[Chris Terwilliger]], and [[Brian Terwilliger]].<ref name="eltwigg">[https://x.com/eltwigg/status/1327604566830043142 Brian Terwilliger], X (14 November 2020)</ref>
